H2_calibration.quote: Note, however, that (B) is also the provision most likely to be used against workarounds like vessel-splitting (item 1).
H2_calibration.note: Also: 'Expect heavy scrutiny of any such claim, including under 18 U.S.C. § 1001'

H1_holdback.quote: Highlighting them before the markup may prompt technical corrections that tighten the bill. Counsel may want to separate the "unworkability" arguments to raise publicly (items 6, 9, 16, 26, 30, 34) from the "operating room" items to hold for post-enactment planning.
